[color=#6d9eeb][size=6][u][b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776454-869883807.png[/img][/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial][size=2]
You paid heaps for your gold clock - Who wouldn't want to have it shimmering and sparkling in the sun adorned with gold hands? This mod replaces the golden clock's hands with golden versions like they should have been to begin with! What's more? Now the gold shimmers and the gems sparkle in all their glory!

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" and "Content\Buildings/Gold Clock.xnb" are replaced with our ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146]Myself[/url]) edited versions.
[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]
Note that the clock only shimmers and sparkles in the sunlight!

[/font][/size]

[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color][/size][font=Arial][size=2]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]3)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]5)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2] Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder as well as, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Animated Gold Clock\assets"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
